description: A wavefolder that folds a signal by remainder division, with a feedback path around the fold and a dry against folded mix

params.text: Multiplies the signal before it is folded, 0 to 10 times, which sets how often the signal runs past the fold point
Returns the folded signal from the previous sample to the fold input, 0 to 200%
Crossfades the fold between unsigned remainder division at the counter-clockwise end and signed remainder division at the clockwise end, the signed form folding around a span twice as wide
Crossfades the output between the signal at the input and the folded signal, 0% folded at the counter-clockwise end and 100% folded at the clockwise end
Sets the voltage at which the signal folds back, 0V to 10V. Randomising the module leaves this knob where it is
Attenuverts the gain input, -100% to 100%; at 10V and fully clockwise it adds 10 to the gain, and at the centre the gain input does nothing
Attenuverts the feedback input, -100% to 100%; at 10V and fully clockwise it adds 100% to the feedback, and at the centre the feedback input does nothing
Attenuverts the shape input, -100% to 100%; at 10V and fully clockwise it moves the shape the whole way from unsigned to signed, and at the centre the shape input does nothing
Attenuverts the mix input, -100% to 100%; at 10V and fully clockwise it moves the mix the whole way to folded, and at the centre the mix input does nothing

inputs.text: The signal to be folded; a polyphonic cable here is summed into one channel
Modulates the gain; the gain attenuverter sets how much of this voltage is added, and with that attenuverter at the centre this jack changes nothing
Modulates the feedback amount; the feed attenuverter sets how much of this voltage is added, and with that attenuverter at the centre this jack changes nothing
Modulates the shape; the shape attenuverter sets how much of this voltage is added, and with that attenuverter at the centre this jack changes nothing
Modulates the mix; the mix attenuverter sets how much of this voltage is added, and with that attenuverter at the centre this jack changes nothing
Adds to the fold knob, one volt of fold point per volt. This jack has no attenuverter, so it moves the fold point at full scale

outputs.text: The mix of the input signal and the folded signal, on one channel

notes: the module is monophonic: a polyphonic cable at the input is summed into one signal and the output carries one channel.
the fold is switched off and the folded signal is 0V whenever the fold point, knob plus input, is within 0.01V of 0V. With the mix fully folded the output is then silent.
the feedback path returns the folded value from the previous sample, so gain and feedback together can build the signal over successive samples rather than reaching a level and holding it.
